description: Source code for RAGFlow provider configuration handling OpenAI-compatible API interactions, including model parsing, URL construction, environment validation, and request transformation.

classes.name: RAGFlowConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for RAGFlow's OpenAI-compatible API, handling model parsing, URL generation, environment validation, and request transformation.

methods.name: _parse_ragflow_model
methods.description: Parses model name in format ragflow/{endpoint_type}/{id}/{model_name} to extract endpoint type, id, and model name.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL based on model format and base URL, handling chat and agent endpoints.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Retrieves provider info (API base, API key, provider name) for RAGFlow, parsing model name.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and sets up headers for API requests, including authorization and content type, and stores actual model name.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms the request payload, replacing model name with the actual model extracted from the RAGFlow format.
